title: On a great adventure to see Kimberly Akimbo across the Atlantic!
transcript: Just got out of Kimberly Akimbo here at the Hampstead Theatre. This is the first U K. Production. And not only is this the U K. Production, this is a completely new production. Different director, different design, same script, I believe. I don't think they've changed anything. Slightly different orchestrations, still the same Kimberly akimbo that you know and love. What's really cool to me about this production is that because the design and the blocking and the direction is so vastly different, I found different moments hitting me differently than they've ever hit before. The set is on a revolve and so on one side you have a complete three storey house. On the other side you have the lockers that then open up to become the library. There is a smaller set for the skating rink. There's a little car that is folded into the gigantic set piece that they'll bring on occasionally. So all of. All of the set pieces are there, but designed vastly different. And the three story house was so cool, especially in the staging for make A wish. Make A wish hit me in ways that it hadn’t before because of her singing throughout this house. The before I go staging at the end absolutely broke me. That that song always hits, but especially tonight. And of course this is a first preview and I always say, when you go to a first preview, know that they are still working on The show, even when the show is like, fully published, still working on the direction, the character choices. And especially in this show, because not only do they have to find their characters, they also have to find their accents because they're all doing American accents that are not naturally how they speak. I definitely noticed some inconsistencies there, but I will say there were people in the audience that at intermission wondered out loud if they had shipped actors from America because the accents were so good to them. So if you're from the U K, you probably won't notice. And because of how technically advanced this production is, there were definitely some transitions that are going to smooth out as they get further into this run. And so that's always what I expect going into a first preview. But for the first preview, this was. This was so solid. I, I loved getting to see Kimberly Akimbo again, and I love getting to see it with a U K. Audience. I'm very curious how they take to the show. There were definitely parts, like anytime I see a show here in the U K. Where I was laughing at different jokes than what the majority of the audience was laughing. But the important thing in any show is that you still cry at the same places. And everyone was, in fact crying by The end. It hits where it needs to hit and that is all that matters. I love this show so much. If you are in the UK I highly recommend going to check it out. It's here until November 7th so it is a limited run as far as tickets go. I got my ticket last minute on today tix. They are doing a digital rush on today tix as well. Tickets are incredibly affordable because, you know, it's the UK.
